THE PERSON BEHIND THE PRACTICE

Ravinder Singh, P.E.

Civil Structural Engineer

More than 40 years handling U.S. government projects. A practical perspective built through responsibility.

Ravinder’s experience spans engineering design, construction management, inspections, and program delivery, with responsibilities as a Project Officer, Construction Chief, Design Engineer, and Program Manager.

County infrastructure leadership, building plan examination, and highway inspection work inform his approach to understanding project requirements, evaluating conditions, and communicating clear next steps.

Through R.S. Kohli & Co., that professional perspective supports engineering, permitting, inspection, consulting, and practical property-service engagements.
